identity.title: Publisher identity
identity.body: The supplied material identifies the business as {companyName}, represented by {representative}. The complete legal identity, legal contact details, registration numbers and details of the person responsible for publication still need verification before publication.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: The project is intended to be hosted on Vercel. The provider ultimately selected, its contact details and the hosting information must be confirmed before the final legal notice is published.

language.title: Language preference
language.body: The website uses the i18n_redirected cookie to remember the selected language, with a configured lifetime of 365 days. When you enter through the root address, this preference, or otherwise your browser language, selects French or English; French is the default. Addresses beginning with /fr or /en keep the requested language. You can change language using the website's selector and delete this cookie in your browser settings.

services.title: Other services
services.body: This version of the application includes no advertising, audience analytics, embedded map or social media widget. Fonts are served by the website. External links open the relevant services when you choose to follow them; those services may apply their own rules. Any cookies and logs added by the hosting service must be checked on the selected deployment.

enquiries.title: Contact inquiries
enquiries.body: The intended contact processing allows the estate to respond to your inquiries. Email and message are required; name and phone number are optional. When enabled and configured, the service sends this information through Resend to the recipient selected by the estate, with a technical identifier to limit duplicate sends. Sending is disabled by default. You can also contact the estate directly by email or phone.

protection.title: Abuse protection
protection.body: The server uses the connection's IP address to limit requests. Shared counters in Upstash Redis contain identifiers calculated from that address and the website origin, without a plain IP address or inquiry content. The IP-related counter expires after 15 minutes; aggregate counters expire after one hour and 24 hours. The application adds no message log or inquiry database. These periods do not describe how long providers retain logs or backups.

review.title: Details to confirm
review.body: The data controller's identity and contact details, legal basis, procedures for exercising rights, actual recipients and providers, processing regions, contractual safeguards, and retention periods at providers and in the estate's mailbox must be confirmed. Hosting logs and deletion practices also need verification. This provisional document establishes no general retention period or location guarantee.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: A lifelong wine enthusiast, I took over a ten-hectare wine estate in Anjou toward the end of my career, after working in a different field. Guided by quality, I am learning this demanding craft with humility, as part of a shared adventure with people and nature.
about.story_title: A change of life inspired by a passion
about.story: After a career in a completely different field, I decided to pursue a project I had long dreamed of: becoming a winegrower. Driven by a lasting passion for wine, I wanted to understand and experience the whole winemaking process, from vine to bottle. Giving myself to it fully, physically and emotionally, felt like a natural choice.

michel.bio: Come wind, rain or snow, Michel is always out working in the vines. Between showers, you may find him walking his dog Rika through the vineyard.

christophe.bio: With over 35 years at a renowned Loire estate, Christophe always has something to share. You may find him inside a vat or among the rows of vines.

tanguy.bio: Studying business at the École supérieure des agricultures in Angers as part of a work-study program, Tanguy can introduce you to the different wines. You may find him at the estate between university sessions.

wines.title: Our wines
wines.intro: Chenin and Grolleau: discover the estate's six wines.

anjou25.title: Anjou blanc sec 2025
anjou25.origin: Chenin grown on our oldest plot, “Rossignolerie”.
anjou25.notes: An aromatic nose with yellow peach notes. A fairly full palate with lime blossom aromas and a lovely acacia finish.

anjou24.title: Anjou blanc sec 2024
anjou24.origin: Chenin grown on our schist-rich terroir, which gives it its mineral character.
anjou24.notes: Aromas of white flowers, pastries and white peach. A structured palate with lovely tension, flinty notes and a light hint of mint.

rose25.title: Rosé de Loire sec 2025
rose25.origin: 100% Grolleau from a small, well-exposed hillside, giving a lovely pink hue and tangy fruit notes.
rose25.notes: A generous, rounded palate with a raspberry finish.

epure.title: White sparkling wine
epure.origin: L'Epure: a cuvée shaped by Chenin, like a carpenter shaping their work.
epure.notes: A lightly brioche-scented nose with green apple aromas. A fruit-led palate opening into notes of white flowers.

eclat.title: Rosé sparkling wine
eclat.origin: L'Eclat: a lively cuvée with a lovely hue from Grolleau and a hint of sweetness.
eclat.notes: Slightly tangy red berry aromas. A rounded, generous palate with a rose finish.

layon25.title: Coteaux du Layon 2025
layon25.origin: Chenin picked at peak ripeness from a vigorous, steep plot called Monts Pertus.
layon25.notes: Ripe fruit aromas, including mango and yellow apple. A gently sweet palate with lavender honey notes and a long finish.
